name: Yuu Takamine
source:
Rather brash and perverted, Yuu is an ordinary human like Takataka and Nerisu’s mother, Kotone. Like Takataka, he has a love for anime, manga, visual novels and light novels that he often talks to with him and Nerisu about. He’s as goofy as him, and the two have a strong friendship that wouldn’t be easily broken. 

Yuu isn't the best at his studies, except for Japanese, which he’s just as good as Nerisu in. It makes his weird chuuni speak unusual, since it’s supposed to be awkward samurai speak to an extent.

When it comes to his fetishes, he prefers average chested women in reality, and thinks that dating Nerisu would be so gross. On the other hand, he is a sensitive guy who has a tendency to be passionate about his hobbies, and he’s very athletic. He’s surprisingly introverted, not really trying to initiate conversation with others and only shows his energetic side around the group or any other close friends he has.
